name: 海枝枝（翠绿纶布）
description: 喜欢用绿色的共生藻打扮自己，光合色素和粘液让珊瑚枝呈现百变的造型。它对光照与水质非常敏感，需要在浅水、光线充足的地方晒足日光浴，获得维持活力所需的能量，否则，可能会凋谢成灰白色。
descriptionEn: It likes to adorn itself with green symbiotic algae, and photosynthetic pigments together with mucus give its coral branches ever-changing shapes. It is very sensitive to light and water quality, and needs to sunbathe thoroughly in shallow, well-lit places to gain the energy required to stay vital; otherwise it may wither into a grayish white.

skills.descriptionEn: Self gains Magic ATK +90%; if the enemy switches spirits this turn, self gains Speed +70.
